findings.title: Wire transcript oracle contradicts mandatory ASCII escaping
findings.minimal_counterexample: The required userMessage Ola-with-accent and leaf (Olá 🌿) is escaped as Ol\u00e1 \ud83c\udf3f by ensure_ascii=True; TS JSON.stringify emits literal Unicode UTF-8. Raw frames differ beyond IDs although decoded values agree.
findings.requirement_needed: Retain raw transcripts; check each framing/encoding independently; compare decoded values exactly with explicit typed ID correspondence and permit semantically equivalent JSON serialization spelling/order. Do not normalize event or payload facts. Make the PY02 pass/fail oracle explicit.

findings.title: Parsed-invalid client response has contradictory error classification
findings.minimal_counterexample: After one fully written pending hello, receive [] followed by LF. TS parses JSON then closes invalid_response/-32085, unknown/false. SPEC line 121 says frame/-32080 whereas line 166 says invalid_response. An ID-less notification has the same disagreement.
findings.requirement_needed: Separate parse/framing failures from parsed-invalid client response envelopes and server request ingress. Use invalid_response/-32085 for parsed batches/notifications on client ingress; retain frame/-32080 for framing/JSON failures and declared extra parser restrictions. Specify kind/code and individual queued/written outcomes in the existing negative oracle.
